bootstrap.precision_rule: max endpoint MCSE <= 0.05 x percentile width, 1000 numerical resamples; independent of significance
bootstrap.procedure: fixed Euro domain/spec original-match refits of the WC ATT; no endpoint DVDS

claim.qualification: Conditional approximate match-cluster inference on the locked supported WC ATT; repeated national teams and nuisance remainder remain limitations; no automatic publication

inference_agreement.interpretation: Agreement is useful, not proof: both can share nuisance bias

influence.interpretation: Fixed-nuisance score screen over all matches/teams; targeted refits of top-ranked units are not complete leave-one-out

independent_dummy_y.denominator: computationally_valid_records; failures and missing allocations separately reported
independent_dummy_y.interpretation: Software null behavior, not identification evidence

within_match_treatment.interpretation: Software null behavior, not identification evidence

sensitivity.limitations: General DVDS identification; published iid binary/continuous efficiency does not establish clustered ternary coverage.
